blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Self-distillation is an emerging approach that trains a model to imitate its own predictions when conditioned on privileged information, such as correct answers or environmental feedback. Recent methods have reported better sample efficiency and generalization than reinforcement learning (RL), but it remains unclear whether these gains extend beyond in-distribution evaluations and whether they stem from privileged distillation. In this paper, we revisit two representative methods, Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), across code, science, tool use, and math reasoning tasks. We find that their reported gains do not consistently generalize to unseen problems and are largely explained by overfitting or transferring existing reasoning behavior, rather than effectively using privileged information. Moreover, self-distillation gradients show weak alignment with policy gradients that directly optimize expected reward, questioning whether they provide an effective direction for policy improvement. Our experiments across Qwen3 models (1.7B-14B) and OLMo-3-7B suggest that effectively leveraging privileged information to improve reasoning remains an open challenge. Our code is available at https://github.com/sleepypandu/does-sd-improve-reasoning
blocks.zh: 自我消化是一种新兴的方法,它训练一种模型在以特权信息为条件时模仿自己的预测,如正确的答案或环境反馈. 与强化学习(RL)相比,最近的方法报告样本效率和通用性更好,但目前还不清楚这些收益是否超出分配评价的范围,以及这些收益是否来自特权分馏。 在本文中,我们重新审视了两种代表性方法,即自我分裂政策优化(SDPO)和On-Policy自我分裂(OPSD),跨越代码,科学,工具使用和数学推理任务. 我们发现,他们所报告的进展并没有始终被概括到看不见的问题,在很大程度上是由于过度调整或转移了现有的推理行为,而不是有效地利用特权信息。 此外,自我消化梯度显示与直接优化预期回报的政策梯度的配合薄弱,质疑梯度是否为改进政策提供了有效方向。 我们跨越Qune3模型(1.7B-14B)和OLMo-3-7B的实验表明,有效利用特权信息改进推理仍然是一个公开的挑战。 我们的代码可见于https://github.com/sleepypandu/ does-sd-improve-reasoning。

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard approach for finetuning large language models (LLMs) on reasoning tasks such as mathematics and coding ( Lambert et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) . As responses in these domains are automatically verifiable, scaling RLVR is straightforward. However, typical RLVR pipelines use binary rewards that indicate only whether the final answer is correct or whether all unit tests pass. Such rewards provide no information on how attempted solutions should be revised. Process reward models score individual reasoning steps ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Cui et al., 2025 ) , but require training additional models.
blocks.zh: 加强可核查奖励的学习(RLVR)已成为微调数学和编码等推理任务的大型语言模型(LLMs)的标准方法(Lambert等,2025;Guo等,2025)。 由于这些领域的反应是自动可核查的,因此缩放RLVR是直截了当的. 然而,典型的RLVR输油管使用二进制奖励,这些奖励只表明最终答案是否正确,或者所有单位测试是否通过. 这种奖励没有说明应如何修订试图采用的解决办法。 过程奖励模型得分个人推理步骤(Wang等,2024;Cui等,2025),但需要训练附加模型.

blocks.en: A recently popularized alternative to RLVR is self-distillation, which requires neither an external stronger model nor an explicit reward function. It exploits the fact that reasoning tasks often come with feedback far richer than the binary outcome that RLVR consumes, such as reference solutions, critiques, error messages, or failing unit tests. In self-distillation, the model samples a trace and is trained to match, at each token along that trace, the distribution of a (teacher) copy of itself that additionally conditions on this privileged information ( Hübotter et al., 2026 ; Shenfeld et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ) . The self-conditioned teacher converts rich but unstructured feedback into a dense, per-token training signal.
blocks.zh: 最近流行的RLVR替代方法是自我消化,这既不需要外部更强大的模型,也不需要明确的奖励功能. 它利用了一个事实,即推理任务往往伴随着比RLVR所消耗的二进制结果更丰富的反馈,如参考解决方案,批评,出错消息,或失败的单位测试. 在自我消化过程中,模型取样了一个痕量,并经过培训,在每一分量上与分发一份(教师)副本的情况相匹配,该副本是对这一特殊信息的额外条件(Hübotter等,2026;Shenfeld等,2026;Zhao等,2026a)。 自备条件的老师会将丰富而无结构的反馈转换成密集而活泼的训练信号.

blocks.en: However, prior work questions the validity of self-distillation objectives as a mechanism to improve the student policy. The self-conditioned teacher’s outputs do not express uncertainty through tokens such as “wait”, “hmmm”, and “perhaps,” so training against it suppresses the model’s ability to correct past mistakes as it reasons and shortens the student’s traces in ways that hurt performance ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2026 ; Kaur et al., 2026 ) . Moreover, the self-conditioned teacher is unable to consistently distinguish between correct and incorrect student generations ( Harne et al., 2026 ; Nguyen et al., 2026 ) . Together, these results raise a more fundamental question: does self-distillation extract useful guidance from privileged information, or are its reported gains driven by simpler mechanisms?
blocks.zh: 然而,以前的工作质疑自我消化目标作为改进学生政策的一种机制的有效性。 自定条件的教师产出并没有通过诸如 " 等待 " 、 " mmm " 和 " 可能 " 等标志来表达不确定性,因此,与其相抗衡的培训抑制了模式纠正过去错误的能力,因为其原因和缩短学生的痕迹的方式会损害业绩(Kim等,2026;Pan等,2026;Kaur等,2026)。 此外,自备条件的教师无法一致区分学生的几代人(Harne等,2026;Nguyen等,2026)。 这些结果共同提出了一个更根本的问题:自我消化是否从特权信息中获取有益的指导,或所报告的成果是否由更简单的机制所驱动?

blocks.en:
We revisit this question through careful reproductions of self-distillation policy optimization (SDPO) ( Hübotter et al., 2026 ) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) . We leverage Qwen3 ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) and Olmo-3 ( Olmo Team, 2025 ) models to ensure our observations hold over a range of model sizes and families. We find that the reported gains from privileged-information self-distillation in reasoning domains are weaker than they appear: • SDPO’s coding gains do not transfer to unseen problems ( Section 4.1 ).
SDPO’s LiveCodeBench v6 ( Jain et al., 2024 ) results train and evaluate on the same set of coding problems. Correcting for this reveals that SDPO overfits to its training problems, reducing the diversity of its solutions ( Figure 1 ), and degrades on held-out problems while policy-gradient training on the same verifiable reward generalizes. • SDPO’s gains in science reasoning and tool use do not generalize out of domain ( Section 4.2 ).
Across five science-reasoning ( Feng et al., 2024 ) and tool-use ( Tang et al., 2023 ) domains, SDPO and GRPO in-domain performances are similar, but in four of five it lowers accuracy on the held-out domains, while GRPO preserves it. • OPSD transfers thinking-mode behavior, not privileged information ( Section 4.3 ).
In math reasoning, privileged information barely changes the self-conditioned teacher’s token distribution ( Figure 2 ), and distilling thinking-mode behavior has a substantially larger effect than privileged information within OPSD’s reported results. • Self-distillation gradients do not align with policy gradients ( Section 4.4 ). Prior work motivates self-distillation as approximate policy improvement by arguing that its gradient aligns with the policy gradient ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ) . This alignment matters because a small update improves expected reward only to the extent that it follows the policy gradient ( Section 3.1 ). We therefore measure how well each method’s training gradient aligns with the policy gradient on held-out problems. On Qwen3 models, OPSD and SDPO gradients are consistently less aligned than GRPO gradients computed on the same training problems and often point away from the held-out policy gradient altogether.

blocks.en: 2 Related works
blocks.zh: 2 相关作品

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR). The goal of reinforcement learning is to maximize the expectation of reward under a policy’s responses. For verifiable tasks in math reasoning and coding, such rewards are assigned by verifying the equivalence between expressions or checking whether a proposed program passes all test-cases. RLVR for LLMs is typically done using policy gradient algorithms ( Williams, 1992 ; Sutton et al., 2000 ) . Although PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) was used in foundational work ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Bai et al., 2022 ) , critic-free methods such as GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) and RLOO ( Kool et al., 2019 ; Ahmadian et al., 2024 ) have become popular due to their simplicity, despite feedback only being given at the trajectory level.
blocks.zh: 加强从可核查的奖励中学习(RLVR)。 加强学习的目标是在政策对策下最大限度地实现奖励的预期。 对于数学推理和编码方面的可核查任务,这种奖励是通过验证表达式之间的等同性或检查拟议程序是否通过所有测试案例来分配的. LLMs的RLVR通常使用政策梯度算法(Williams,1992;Sutton等人,2000年)。 虽然PPO(Schulman等,2017年)被用在了基础工作上(Oyang等,2022年;Bai等,2022年),但GRPO(Shao等,2024年)和RLOO(Kool等,2019年;Ahmadian等,2024年)等无批评性的方法由于简洁而变得受欢迎,尽管只有轨迹层面给出了反馈.

blocks.en: On-policy distillation (OPD). Unlike classic distillation, which tries to match teacher-generated outputs ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) , on-policy distillation seeks to boost performance by minimizing per-token divergences between student logits π θ ( ⋅ | x , y < t ) \pi_{\theta}(\cdot|x,y_{<t}) and teacher logits π T ( ⋅ | x , y < t ) \pi_{T}(\cdot|x,y_{<t}) along prefixes sampled from the student policy ( Lu and Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Gu et al., 2023 ) . OPD has been shown to be effective in post-training small-models ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) and merging the capabilities of multiple domain-specialist expert models ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Kimi Team, 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 政策分解。 与经典的蒸馏法(Hinton等,2015年)不同,政策蒸馏法力求通过尽量减少学生记录(Lu and Think Machines Lab,2025年;Xu等,2026年;Gu等,2023年;Gu等)之间按学生政策抽取的分数,提高绩效。 实践证明,OPD在培训后小型模型(Quen Team,2025年)和整合多个域-专家模型的能力(徐等,2026年;Kimi Team,2026年;Ma等,2026年)方面是有效的.

blocks.en: Self-distillation and privileged information. Instead of relying on an external stronger model, self-distillation ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ; Hübotter et al., 2026 ) parameterizes the teacher distribution as π T ( ⋅ | x , y < t ) = π θ ( ⋅ | x , z , y < t ) \pi_{T}(\cdot|x,y_{<t})=\pi_{\theta}(\cdot|x,z,y_{<t}) , with privileged information z z which is derived from a reference solution or environmental feedback. This purportedly moves the student towards a higher-reward policy, transferring the reference solution’s reasoning content.
blocks.zh: 自我消化和特权信息。 与其依赖外部更强大的模型,不如将教师分布参数化(Shenfeld等,2026年;Zhao等,2026年a;Hübotter等,2026年t),将教师分布参数化为: π T (⋅ | x, y < t) = π (⋅ | x, z, y < t)\ pi_{ T } (\cdot|x, y_{<t}) =\ pi_{\theta } (\cdot|x, z, y_{<t}),其特权信息z 取自参考解决方案或环境反馈. 这据称使学生转向高回报政策,转移了参考解决方案的推理内容。

blocks.en: Limitations of self-distillation. Prior work documents several failure modes of self-distillation: SDPO generalizes poorly out of distribution and in continual learning settings ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , self-distillation degrades thinking models by suppressing backtracking behavior and collapsing response lengths ( Kaur et al., 2026 ; Harne et al., 2026 ) , and the self-conditioned teacher fails to distinguish correct from incorrect student solutions ( Nguyen et al., 2026 ) . Concurrently, Shrestha and Tessier (2026) show that OPSD’s gains stem from thinking-mode transfer rather than privileged information. Methods that retain GRPO and use the teacher only to reweight advantages such as Pan et al. (2026) fall outside our scope, as we study the self-distillation objective in isolation. We provide an extended discussion of existing work on the limitations of self-distillation, and of how our paper differs from each, in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 自我消化的限制。 先前的工作记录了几种自我沉淀的失败模式:SDPO在分布和持续学习环境中的概括性差(Wang等人,2026年),自我沉淀通过抑制回溯行为和崩溃的反应长度来降低思维模式(Kaur等人,2026年;Harne等人,2026年),自建条件的教师未能将错误的学生解决方案区分开来(Nguyen等人,2026年). 与此同时,Shrestha和Tessier(2026年)表明OPSD的收益来自思维模式的转移而不是特权信息. 保留GRPO的方法,使用老师只是为了重取Pan等优势. (2026)在我们孤立地研究自我消化目标时,不属于我们的范围. 我们在附录A中详细讨论了关于自我消化的局限性的现有工作,以及我们的文件与文件有何不同。

blocks.en: 3.1 Equivalence between Policy Gradient, SFT, and Distillation
blocks.zh: 3.1 政策渐进、SFT和扭曲之间的等同性

blocks.en: Policy gradient improves the policy by ascending expected reward, whereas self-distillation moves the student towards a teacher, so whether it improves depends on the teacher. Self-distillation implicitly assumes that the self-conditioned teacher approximates the KL-regularized optimal policy relative to the current policy, π ∗ ​ ( y | x ) ∝ π θ ​ ( y | x ) ​ exp ⁡ ( R ⁡ ( x , y ) / β ) \pi^{*}(y|x)\propto\pi_{\theta}(y|x)\exp(R(x,y)/\beta) , which we call the optimal teacher ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ) . We show that for this teacher, the policy gradient, SFT on samples from π ∗ \pi^{*} , and on-policy distillation towards π ∗ \pi^{*} share the same update direction. Hence, if the assumption holds, self-distillation gradients should align with the policy gradient, which we test in Section 4.4 .

blocks.zh: 4 实验结果.

blocks.en: We now examine whether the reported gains of prior self-distillation works reflect the generalization performance of policy gradients ( Section 4.1 ), require reasoning behavior ( Section 4.2 ), transfer via privileged information ( Section 4.3 ), and have gradients that align with the policy gradient as Proposition 3.1 would require of an optimal teacher ( Section 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们现在审查以往自我消化工程报告的收益是否反映了政策梯度的一般表现(第4.1节),是否要求推理行为(第4.2节),通过特权信息进行转让(第4.3节),是否具有与政策梯度相一致的梯度,因为建议3.1需要一名最佳教师(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 SDPO does not generalize to new coding problems
blocks.zh: 4.1 SDPO没有概括到新的编码问题

blocks.en: Harne et al. (2026) suggest that the self-conditioned teacher is heavily biased towards the reference solution given in context in a way that does not generalize, which makes the coding gains reported by SDPO ( Hübotter et al., 2026 ) surprising. We observe that SDPO’s coding evaluations reuse its training problems, thus not cleanly measuring generalization. We hypothesize that SDPO’s coding gains stem from this discrepancy.
blocks.zh: Harne等 (2026年) 暗示,自备条件的老师对上下文给出的参考解决方案存在严重偏颇,其方式并不概括,这使得SDPO(Hübotter等,2026年)报告的编码收益令人惊讶. 我们注意到,SDPO的编码评价重新利用了它的训练问题,因此不能对通用性进行干净的测量。 我们假设SDPO的编码收益来自于这一差异。

blocks.en: SDPO builds its teacher from privileged information available only at training time. On coding tasks, the teacher sees a successful student rollout from the same batch along with environment feedback on execution errors on test cases. They claim that SDPO improves 7.6 % 7.6\% over GRPO baselines in accuracy on LiveCodeBench v6 ( Jain et al., 2024 ) evaluations. We construct a clean split of the LCB data, reproduce SDPO overall gains on their data split, and observe that SDPO does not lead to performance gains when evaluated on an unseen test set.
blocks.zh: SDPO利用仅在培训时才获得的特权信息来培养教师。 在编码任务方面,教师看到同一批学生成功推出,同时对测试案件执行错误的环境反馈。 他们声称,在LiveCode Bench v6(Jain等,2024年)评价中,SDPO比GRPO基线提高了7.6%. 我们构建一个干净的LCB数据分拆,复制SDPO在数据分拆上的总体收益,并观察到SDPO在对一个隐形测试集进行评价时不会导致性能增益.

The 20000 20000 training generations reported by Hübotter et al. (2026) is marked in red.

blocks.en: Setup. LiveCodeBench v6 pairs each competitive programming problem with a set of test cases. Concretely, the original work trains on all problems with half of each problem’s test cases removed, and evaluates on the unmodified dataset. To separate memorization from generalization, we instead split the problems into disjoint, equal-size sets 𝒫 train \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{train}} and 𝒫 test \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{test}} , giving three evaluation groups: train_seen (test cases used during training), train_unseen (held-out test cases of problems in 𝒫 train \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{train}} ), and test_unseen (all test cases of problems in 𝒫 test \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{test}} ).
blocks.zh: 设相. LiveCode Bench v6将每个竞争性编程问题与一组测试案例相配. 具体地说,最初的工作是对所有问题的训练,因为每个问题的测试案例有一半被取出,并对未经修改的数据集进行评估。 为了将记忆与通化区分开来,我们把问题分成了脱节,等分大小的 P 列车\mathcal{P}_{\ mathrm{train}和 P mathcal{P}_{\ mathrm{ test}, 赋予了三个评价组: train_seen (在训练中使用的测试案例), train_unsen (P train\mathcal{P}_{\ mathrm{train}) 和 test-unseen (P test{mathcal{P}_{\ mathrm{ test}中所有测试问题的案例).

blocks.en: Results. We train Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Olmo-3-7B-Instruct on this split with SDPO and GRPO for 200 steps, four seeds each, otherwise following the setup of Hübotter et al. (2026) ; we provide our hyperparameters in Section E.1 . Figure 3 shows Qwen3-8B; results for the other two models and tables of accuracies are in Section D.1 .
blocks.zh: 结果。 我们在与SDPO和GRPO的这次分出上训练了Qune3-8B,Qune3-14B和Olmo-3-7B-Instruct,共200步,每步有4个种子,否则在Hübotter等人(2026年)成立之后;我们在E.1节中提供了我们的超参数。 图3显示的是Qune3-8B;其他两种模型和加速表的结果载于D.1节。

blocks.en: SDPO does not improve on new problems. Over 200 steps, GRPO improves test_unseen by 3.7 3.7 , 4.9 4.9 , and 2.6 2.6 points on Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, whereas SDPO changes it by − 2.5 -2.5 , − 0.5 -0.5 , and − 9.9 -9.9 points. The disparity is largest on Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, where SDPO ends 13.1 13.1 points below GRPO ( 21.0 21.0 vs. 34.1 34.1 ). In summary, we find that mimicking a privileged teacher does not generalize to new problems.
blocks.zh: SDPO在新问题上没有改进. 超过200个步骤,GRPO在Qune3-8B,Qune3-14B,和Olmo-3-7B-Instruct上改进了3.7 3.7分,4.9 4.9分和2.6 2.6分的测试-未见,而SDPO则将其修改为−2.5-2.5分,−0.5-0.5分和− 9.9-9.9分. 在奥尔莫-3-7B-Instruct上差距最大,SDPO结束于GRPO下13.1 13.1分(21.0 21.0对34.1 34.1. 简而言之,我们发现模仿一位特权教师并不能概括到新问题。

blocks.en: SDPO does generalize to held-out test cases. SDPO’s gains on train_seen largely carry over to train_unseen ( + 23.1 +23.1 vs. + 18.4 +18.4 on Qwen3-8B, + 22.5 +22.5 vs. + 17.2 +17.2 on Qwen3-14B, and + 18.3 +18.3 vs. + 16.7 +16.7 on Olmo-3-7B-Instruct), retaining 76–91% of the gain compared with 81–103% for GRPO. SDPO therefore overfits at the level of training problems instead of at the level of unit tests, and produces fewer distinct solutions per training problem than GRPO ( Figure 1 ). We hypothesize this is because a problem’s test cases check the same specification, so a program that passes the seen test cases is usually correct and passes the held-out ones too. This reconciles our results with those of Hübotter et al. (2026) ; indeed, evaluating on train_seen and train_unseen at 80 steps across all three models, we find that SDPO beats GRPO.
blocks.zh: SDPO的确将搁置测试案例概括起来. SDPO在列车上的增益_观光站基本结转到列车_观光站(Qwen3-8B上+23.1+23.1对18.4+18.4,Qwen3-14B上+22.5+22.5对17.2+17.2,Ollmo-3-7B-structure上+18.3+18.3对16.7+16.7),保留了76-91%的增益,而GRPO则保留了81-103 %. 因此,SDPO在培训问题层面,而不是在单位测试层面,与GRPO相比,每个培训问题产生的不同解决办法较少(图1)。 我们假设这是因为一个问题的测试案例检查了相同的规格,所以一个通过所见测试案例的程序通常是正确的,并且也通过被搁置的。 这调和了我们和Hübotter等人(2026年)的结果;事实上,在所有三种模式中,在80步的火车上,我们发现SDPO击败了GRPO。

blocks.en: On Qwen3 models, GRPO overtakes SDPO on training problems with longer training. SDPO improves faster early on but then slows, while GRPO keeps improving and overtakes it after ∼ \sim 160 steps on both train_seen and train_unseen . At 200 steps on Qwen3-8B, GRPO scores 50.9 50.9 on train_seen and 46.2 46.2 on train_unseen , versus 48.9 48.9 and 44.0 44.0 for SDPO; on Qwen3-14B, GRPO scores 54.1 54.1 and 49.2 49.2 , versus 51.9 51.9 and 45.4 45.4 . The ∼ \sim 80-step comparison of Hübotter et al. (2026) therefore does not reflect performance at convergence—at 80 steps, GRPO is still improving and SDPO’s advantage disappears with further training. In Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, SDPO continues to outperform GRPO on training problems.
blocks.zh: 在Quen3型号上,GRPO超越了SDPO在训练上与更长时间训练的问题. SDPO在早期改善更快,但随后变慢,而GRPO则在\sim 160步后不断改进并超越了它,两列列车_观光站和火车-观光站. 在Qwen3-8B的200步上,GRPO的分数为:列车50.9 50.9分,列车46.2 46.2分;而SDPO的分数为:48.9 48.9分和44.0 44.0分;在Qwen3-14B的分数为:54.1 54.1分和49.2 49.2分;对51.9 51.9分和45.4 45.4分 . 因此,Hübotter等人(2026年)的\sim 80步比较不能反映趋同的表现——在80步,GRPO仍在改善,而SDPO的优势随着进一步培训而消失。 在Olmo-3-7B-Instruct中,SDPO在培训问题上的表现仍然超过GPRO.

blocks.en: 4.2 SDPO does not generalize OOD in science reasoning and tool use
blocks.zh: 4.2 SDPO在科学推理和工具使用方面没有概括OD

blocks.en: Given that SDPO overfits on coding problems, we also examine its reported gains in science reasoning and tool use, where Hübotter et al. (2026) find that SDPO outperforms GRPO. We ask how broadly this advantage holds and whether it remains in out-of-domain settings.
blocks.zh: 鉴于SDPO在编码问题上的过度应用,我们也考察了它所报告的在科学推理和工具使用上的进展,Hübotter等人(2026年)认为SDPO的成绩优于GRPO. 我们问,这种优势在多大范围内存在,是否仍然存在于域外环境中。

Rows vary across training domains while columns vary across evaluation domains. OOD change is defined as the change in mean accuracy over all non-training domains.

blocks.en: Setup. Hübotter et al. (2026) evaluate SDPO on SciKnowEval multiple-choice science questions ( Feng et al., 2024 ) and ToolAlpaca ( Tang et al., 2023 ) , with teachers conditioned on correct neighboring solutions. Unlike more difficult math and coding tasks, where reaching the answer requires multi-step derivation, answers in these domains can be directly produced by choosing among four options or emitting an API call whose structure is largely determined by the prompt. We train Qwen3-8B with SDPO and GRPO on each domain for 200 200 steps over four seeds, following their settings, and evaluate each trained model on the held-out validation set of all five domains; we report our hyperparameters in Section E.1 and full training curves in Section D.2 .
blocks.zh: 设相. Hübotter等人(2026年)在SciknowEval多选择科学问题上评价SDPO(冯等,2024年)和工具阿尔帕卡(唐等,2023年),教师以正确的相邻解决方案为条件. 与比较困难的数学和编码任务不同,在达到答案需要多步骤的衍生,这些领域的答案可以通过在四个选项中选择或者发布一个API调用来直接生成,其结构主要由快取决定. 我们在每个领域用SDPO和GRPO进行200个步骤的Quen3-8B训练,按照四个种子的设置,在四个种子上进行200个步骤的训练,并在所有五个域的被搁置验证组上评价每一个经过训练的模型;我们在E.1节中报告我们的超参数,在D.2节中报告完整的训练曲线。

blocks.en:
SDPO improves on the training domain faster, but GRPO converges to comparable accuracies. In biology, chemistry, and physics, SDPO improves in-domain accuracy faster than GRPO early in training, while GRPO improves gradually over all 200 200 steps ( Figure 6 ).
By step 200 200 , the two methods are within one standard deviation of each other in biology, material, and physics (SDPO vs. GRPO: 52.5 52.5 vs. 51.0 51.0 , 73.5 73.5 vs. 76.2 76.2 , and 73.1 73.1 vs. 72.4 72.4 ); the only clear differences are chemistry, where SDPO leads ( 77.7 77.7 vs. 68.9 68.9 ), and tool use, where GRPO leads ( 53.5 53.5 vs. 66.3 66.3 ) ( Table 1 ). Averaged over the five domains, both methods reach similar in-domain accuracy ( 66.1 66.1 for SDPO and 67.0 67.0 for GRPO, up from 49.6 49.6 for the base model).

SDPO更快地改进了培训领域,但GRPO与可比较的速率汇合. 在生物学,化学,和物理学方面,SDPO在培训初期比GRPO更快地提高域内精度,而GRPO则在所有200个步骤上逐渐提高(图6).

blocks.en: SDPO degrades out of domain, while GRPO does not. Training SDPO on any of the four science domains lowers average out-of-domain accuracy by 7.1 7.1 to 16.6 16.6 points, whereas GRPO slightly improves it ( + 0.9 +0.9 to + 1.6 +1.6 ; Table 1 ). Training on tool use is the exception, with SDPO slightly improving out-of-domain accuracy ( + 0.9 +0.9 ), with GRPO slightly lowering it ( − 2.1 -2.1 ). The drops are largest when evaluating on material, physics, and tool use, where SDPO’s accuracy peaks early in training and then declines steadily ( Figure 6 ). SDPO’s in-domain gains thus come at the cost of out-of-domain performance that policy-gradient training generally preserves.
blocks.zh: SDPO退化出域外,而GRPO则没有. 在四个科学领域中任何一个领域的训练SDPO平均域外精度会降低7.1至16.6 16.6分,而GRPO则稍有改进(+0.9+0.9至+1.6+1.6;表1). 工具使用培训是例外,而SDPO略微提高域外精度(+0.9+0.9),而GRPO稍有降低(−2.1-2.1)。 在对材料、物理和工具使用进行评价时,下降幅度最大,SDPO的精确度在培训初期就达到高峰,然后稳步下降(图6)。 因此,SDPO的域内收益是以政策级培训通常保持的域外业绩为代价的。

blocks.en: 4.3 OPSD gains depend on thinking mode transfer, not privileged information

blocks.en: OPSD ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) reports gains on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25 ( Mathematical Association of America, 2024 ; Balunović et al., 2025 ) by distilling a thinking-on Qwen3 teacher conditioned on a reference solution z z into the same model with thinking off ( Appendix C ). The teacher thus differs from the student in two ways: it sees z z , and it thinks.

blocks.en: We therefore seek to isolate the influence of the content of z z with the teacher thinking mode. If OPSD gains come from conditioning on z z , replacing it with the reference solution of a different problem or removing it entirely should degrade performance.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们试图用老师思维模式孤立z z的内容的影响. 如果OPSD的增益来自z z上的条件,取而代之的是不同问题的参考解决方案,或者完全去除它应该会降低性能.

blocks.en: Setup. Following Zhao et al. (2026a) , we train on OpenThoughts ( Guha et al., 2025 ) math problems, each paired with a reference solution. We fix the student to thinking-off and ablate the teacher’s thinking mode (on or off) and its privileged information: the problem’s own reference solution (ref z z ), no reference solution (no z z ), or the reference solution of a different problem (shuffled z z ). The teacher template is otherwise fixed, so the three differ only in the content of z z .

blocks.en: Zhao et al. (2026a) train Qwen3-1.7B to 8B with OPSD for 100 steps and compare against thinking-on GRPO (500 steps) and SFT (100 steps). To evaluate fully converged performance, we train OPSD and SFT for 200 steps and GRPO, with thinking on and off, for 500 steps, and evaluate on the same datasets with thinking on and off. As Shenfeld et al. (2026) ; Hübotter et al. (2026) suggest self-distillation works better for larger models, we also test Qwen3-14B and a second model family, Olmo-3-7B-Instruct. As the latter has no thinking toggle, we instead compare two teachers given the same privileged information: the student itself (self-distillation) and Olmo-3-7B-Think, a separately trained thinking model from the same family (cross-model distillation), which cleanly separates privileged information from thinking-mode transfer. We report Qwen3-8B validation results in Table 2 , remaining results and statistics in Section D.3 , and hyperparameters in Table 24 .

blocks.en: The content of z z does not matter. Holding the teacher’s thinking mode and the evaluation mode fixed, we ablate z z ; on a sample rollout, removing it barely changes the teacher’s token probabilities ( Figure 2 ). “No z z ” often matches or outperforms “ref z z ”, especially in Zhao et al. (2026a) ’s original setting (thinking teachers and thinking-on evaluations), and “ref z z ” achieves the best average accuracy in only three of 18 18 configurations, each by under one point. In the remaining thinking-on evaluations, the best choice is always “no z z ” or “shuffled z z ”. Except for thinking-off evaluations with a thinking-on teacher, the average accuracies of the three choices of z z lie within 3.6 3.6 points of each other in every configuration other than Qwen3-1.7B with a non-thinking teacher (up to 5.2 5.2 ; Table 2 , Section D.3 ). With a thinking-on teacher, thinking-off accuracy varies more across z z (up to 11.7 11.7 points), but “ref z z ” is never the best choice: “no z z ” or “shuffled z z ” beats it by up to 11.5 11.5 points on Qwen3-8B. At every scale, a variant lacking either the presence or the relevance of a correct reference matches “ref z z ”, so neither is required for OPSD’s gains.

blocks.en: Thinking-on gains are small and do not discriminate between hypotheses. OPSD’s headline results are thinking-on evaluations of students trained with thinking teachers, which Zhao et al. (2026a) attribute to teacher reasoning transfer. Beyond the smallest model, gains are modest ( 7.4 7.4 , 0.8 0.8 , 2.2 2.2 , and 1.1 1.1 points for Qwen3-1.7B to Qwen3-14B for the best z z ), and every variant tested recovers them: thinking-off distillation ( 6.1 6.1 , 0.8 0.8 , 1.8 1.8 , and 0.7 0.7 ), any choice of z z , and, on Qwen3-8B, a loss restricted to the last 10 % 10\% of tokens ( Section D.5 ). Thinking-on gains are thus not evidence for any particular transfer mechanism, so we focus on thinking-off evaluations, the student’s native inference mode.

blocks.en: Thinking-on teachers induce student thinking. Rather than improving student direct-answer capabilities, OPSD with a thinking teacher relies on thinking-mode transfer. Enabling teacher thinking improves average thinking-off accuracy by 7.6 7.6 , 22.9 22.9 , 17.3 17.3 , and 28.9 28.9 points for Qwen3-1.7B to Qwen3-14B, whereas replacing ref z z with shuffled z z changes it by 2.15 2.15 , − 0.2 -0.2 , − 0.15 -0.15 , and − 0.15 -0.15 points. Likewise, Olmo-3-7B-Instruct gains 3.6 3.6 points with a self-teacher but 13.8 13.8 with Olmo-3-7B-Think, averaged over choices of z z ( Table 11 ). Since Zhao et al. (2026a) report only results with a thinking teacher, their remaining thinking-off gains are driven by the teacher’s thinking mode, not by privileged information. This transfer is visible in the students’ outputs: in thinking-off evaluations, Qwen3 students distilled from a thinking teacher often emit an orphan </think> token, closing a thinking block that the chat template has already closed ( Appendix C ). These rollouts reason in the first person, box an answer, emit </think> , then write a clean solution, mirroring a thinking-on response ( Figures 9 , 7 and 8 ). Among on-policy methods, orphan tokens occur mainly in thinking-off rollouts from OPSD with thinking teachers (up to 69.9 % 69.9\% ); GRPO and the base model produce none, and OPSD with a thinking-off teacher at most 6.7 % 6.7\% . Thinking-on teachers also increase response length by 2.72 2.72 to 5.82 5.82 times, approaching the base model’s thinking-on lengths ( Table 14 , Section D.3 ), whereas length stays more stable with teacher thinking disabled ( 0.8 0.8 to 2.52 2.52 times the base model’s). Thus, with teacher thinking enabled, OPSD’s thinking-off gains come from forcing thinking-mode behavior into thinking-off mode, which requires no privileged information.

OPSD与其提高学生的直接回答能力,不如说有思想老师的OPSD依赖于思维-模式转移. 使教师思考能力提高了平均思考精度,提高了7.6分,22.9分22.9分,17.3分17.3分17.3分和28.9分28.9分Qune3–1.7B至Qune3–14B分,而用shuffed z z取而代之的 ref z z 则修改了2.15分2.15分,−0.2–0.2分,−0.15–0.15分;−0.15–0.15分. 同样,Olmo-3-7B-Instruct与一名自学教师获得3.6分,但与Olmo-3-7B-Think获得13.8分,平均胜于z z的选择(表11)。 由于赵等(2026a)只报告有思想老师的成绩,所以他们剩下的思潮收益是由老师的思考模式所驱动,而不是由特权信息所驱动. 这种转移在学生的产出中是显而易见的:在反省评价中,Qune3学生从思维老师那里蒸馏出一个 " /想 " 的孤儿,关闭了聊天模板已经关闭的思维障碍(附录C)。 第一个人的这些推出理由,输入一个答案,放出 " /想 " ,然后写出一个干净的解决方案,反映一个思考中的反应(图9、7和8)。 在政策方法中,孤儿标志主要出现在与思想教师一起从OPSD(最高69.9%为69.9\%;GPRO和基模没有产生;OPSD则最多为6.7%为6.7%为6.7\%. 思考型教师的响应长度也增加了2.72 2.72到5.82 5.82倍,接近了基模型的思维-接力长度(表14,D.3节),而长度则与教师思维残疾(0.8-2.52 2.52倍于基模型)保持更稳定. 因此,随着教师思维的启动,OPSD的思考收益来自于强迫思维模式行为进入思考模式,这不需要特权信息。

blocks.en:
Setup. Practical self-distillation losses differ from the idealized objectives of Proposition 3.1 : they use other divergences such as Jensen–Shannon, per-token clipping, top- k k logit approximations, and EMA teachers ( Equation 3 ), so rather than testing the proposition’s equality directly, we test a consequence: a method whose teacher approximates the optimal teacher should update the model in the same direction as the policy gradient. We therefore measure the cosine similarity between each method’s training gradient and a reference , the GRPO gradient on held-out problems, which is the policy gradient direction that increases reward on new problems. To a first order approximation, a small step along a method’s gradient increases held-out reward if its cosine similarity with the reference is positive, and decreases it if negative.
All gradients are estimated at the base model: on-policy RL favors high-reward policies that stay close to the base model in KL ( Shenfeld et al., 2025 ) , so we test whether the teacher is KL-optimal relative to the base model. We use the same setup as Section 4.1 and Section 4.3 : for math, methods train on OpenThoughts and the reference is GRPO nothink {}_{\text{nothink}} on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25 (held-out math policy gradient); for LiveCodeBench v6, methods train on train_seen and the reference is GRPO on test_unseen . We report our complete results in Section D.6 . Since cosine similarity is a nonlinear function of the pooled gradients and we estimate gradients over four seeds, we estimate its error with a leave-one-seed-out jackknife; we detail our gradient estimation method in Section E.3 .

设相. 实际的自我消化损失与Proposition 3.1的理想目标不同:它们使用其他差异,如Jensen–Shannon,按键剪接,顶端-kk对数相近,以及EMA教师(方程式 3 ) , 因此,我们不直接测试命题的平等性,而是测试一个结果:一种教师与最佳教师相近的方法应该以政策梯度相同的方向更新模型。 因此,我们衡量每种方法的训练梯度与参照度,即关于被搁置问题的GRPO梯度之间的同心相似性,这是增加新问题奖励的政策梯度方向。 就第一顺序近似而言,如果某一方法的梯度与参考物的同位素相似性为正等值,则沿着该方法的梯度走一小步会增加悬赏,如果负则减少悬赏。
所有梯度都是在基准模型中估算的:在政策上RL偏好与KL中的基础模型相近的高回报政策(Shenfeld等,2025年),因此我们测试教师相对于基准模型是否为KL-优化. 我们使用与第4.1节和第4.3节相同的设置:对于数学,OpenThoughts上的方法列车,其参考文献是GRPO nothink {text{nothink}关于AIME24, AIME25, 和HMMT25(控出数学政策梯度);对于LiveCode Bench v6, 列车上的方法列车_seen,其参考文献是GRPO on test_unseen. 我们在D.6节中报告我们的全部结果。 由于同位素相似性是集合梯度的非线性函数,而且我们估计了四个种子的梯度,因此我们用一种子一刀估计出它的错误;我们在E.3节中详细介绍了我们的梯度估计方法。

blocks.en: OPSD points away from the held-out math policy gradient. Across Qwen3-1.7B to 14B, GRPO nothink {}_{\text{nothink}} is the only method with positive cosine similarity with the held-out policy gradient on every model ( + 0.018 +0.018 to + 0.166 +0.166 ), and clearly so on Qwen3-8B and 14B ( + 0.118 ± 0.050 +0.118\pm 0.050 and + 0.166 ± 0.029 +0.166\pm 0.029 ; Tables 4 and 18 ). In contrast, all 24 24 OPSD variants have negative cosine similarity ( − 0.205 -0.205 to − 0.067 -0.067 ). On Qwen3-8B, the six variants lie between − 0.172 -0.172 and − 0.157 -0.157 , within each other’s error bars. Notably, OPSD with a thinking-on teacher points away from the held-out policy gradient despite its large thinking-off gains ( Table 2 ): rather than moving the student towards its own high-reward solutions like policy gradients, it improves performance by matching the teacher’s thinking style ( Section 4.3 ). Instead, on Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, GRPO and all six OPSD variants have small positive cosine similarity ( + 0.026 +0.026 to + 0.062 +0.062 ), but their jackknife errors ( 0.021 0.021 to 0.054 0.054 ) are comparable to the values themselves, so none are clearly resolved from zero ( Table 19 ).
blocks.zh: OPSD指向远离被搁置的数学政策梯度. 纵观Quen3-1.7B到14B,GPRO nothink {text{nothink}}}是唯一与每个模型上被扣出的政策梯度(+0.018+0.018到+0.166+0.166)具有正同位素相似性的方法,在Qune3-8B和14B(+0.118±0.050+0.118\pm0.050和+0.166±0.166\pm0.029;表4和18)上显然如此. 相形之下,所有24个OPSD变体都有负同位素相似性(−0.205-0.205到−0.067-0.067. 在Qwen3-8B上,六个变体位于−0.172-0.172到−0.157-0.157之间,在对方的错误栏内. 值得指出的是,有思维的教师的OPSD指出,尽管有巨大的思考收益(表2 ) , 却远离被搁置的政策梯度:与其将学生转向自己的高回报解决方案,如政策梯度,不如通过匹配教师的思维风格来提高绩效(第4.3节)。 相反地,在Olmo-3-7B-Instruct上,GRPO和所有6个OPSD变体都有小正余弦相近性(+0.026+0.026到+0.062+0.062),但是它们的千刀出错(0.021 0.021到0.054 0.054)与数值本身是可比较的,因此没有从零中明显解决(表19).

blocks.en: SDPO gradients are less aligned than GRPO gradients. On LiveCodeBench v6, SDPO is less aligned with the held-out policy gradient than GRPO on all three models, and points away from it on Qwen3-8B ( Table 4 ). These results are consistent with SDPO’s failure to improve test_unseen accuracy ( Section 4.1 ), suggesting the self-distillation objective is only weakly correlated with generalizable reward maximization.
blocks.zh: SDPO梯度与GRPO梯度相去甚远. 在LiveCode Bench v6上,SDPO与所有三种模型的被搁置政策梯度比GRPO不太一致,并在Qune3-8B上指出它(表4). 这些结果与SDPO未能提高测试/未见的准确性(第4.1节)是一致的,表明自我消化目标与一般的奖励最大化只有微弱的联系。

blocks.en: Self-distillation gradients have low variance but are misaligned. OPSD and SDPO gradients are nearly identical across seeds: their gradient noise scale ( McCandlish et al., 2018 ) , a normalized measure of variance across seeds where 0 0 is noiseless ( Section E.3 ), is at most 0.05 0.05 , versus 1.97 1.97 to 4.11 4.11 for GRPO across all models (see Section D.6 ). Self-distillation thus delivers the low-variance signal it promises, but that signal does not point along the held-out policy gradient: the self-conditioned teacher does not approximate the optimal teacher of Proposition 3.1 .
blocks.zh: 自沉梯度差异小,但错位。 OPSD和SDPO的梯度在种子之间几乎相同:梯度噪声分级(McCandlish等,2018年),这是所有型号0为无噪声的种子间差异的常态测量(E.3节),最高为0.050.05,而GRPO为1.97 1.97 4.11 4.11 (见D.6节)。 因此,自我消化传递出它所承诺的低变异信号,但这一信号并不指向被搁置的政策梯度:自我设置条件的老师并不接近建议3.1的最佳老师.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: Our experiments are limited to the Qwen3 and Olmo model families and the SDPO and OPSD self-distillation recipes. We do not address the more recent developments on self-distillation techniques, which include harnesses ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) , contrastive formulations ( Pan et al., 2026 ) , or more complex aggregation of feedback from neighboring rollouts ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , which may combat the limitations of these self-distillation methods. Moreover, we focus on verifiable domains and acknowledge that self-distillation has use cases in non-verifiable settings ( Buening et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的实验仅限于Quen3和Olmo模型家庭,以及SDPO和OPSD自我消化配方. 我们不讨论最近有关自消化技术的发展,这些技术包括:自消化法(赵等,2026b),对比性配方(潘等,2026),或从相邻的推广法(于等,2026)中更复杂的反馈集合法,可以消除自消化方法的局限性. 此外,我们注重可核查的领域,并承认在不可核查的环境下,自我消化使用的案例(Buening等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We show that the gains attributed to privileged self-distillation either do not generalize or do not come from privileged information. SDPO’s improvements on LiveCodeBench v6 are confined to problems seen during training, and its gains in other domains are come at the cost of out-of-distribution performance. OPSD’s math gains rely on thinking-mode transfer, with privileged information having little effect. Finally, self-distillation gradients do not align with the policy gradient on held-out problems, indicating that the self-conditioned teacher does not approximate the optimal teacher. Together, these results highlight the need to develop principled reinforcement learning methods that can exploit privileged information.
blocks.zh: 我们表明,特权自我消化带来的收益要么不是一般化,要么不是来自特权信息。 SDPO对LiveCode Bench v6的改进仅限于训练期间所见出的问题,它在其他领域的成就是以分配外业绩为代价的。 OPSD的数学收益依赖于思维模式的转移,而特权信息效果甚微. 最后,自我消化梯度与关于被搁置问题的政策梯度不一致,表明自建条件的教师并不接近最佳教师。 这些成果共同突出表明,需要制定原则性强化学习方法来利用特权信息。

blocks.en: Appendix A Extended related works
blocks.zh: 附录A 扩展相关工程

blocks.en: We divide existing work on the limitations of self-distillation techniques into the following:
blocks.zh: 我们把关于自我消化技术局限性的现有工作分为以下几部分:

blocks.en: Empirical re-evaluations. Wang et al. (2026) demonstrate that SDPO struggles to generalize to out-of-distribution domains, and fail in continual learning settings where GRPO succeeds. Kaur et al. (2026) highlight that self-distillation degrades thinking-models; with previous works primarily focusing on instruction-tuned models. Concurrent to our work, Shrestha and Tessier (2026) ; Zhang et al. (2026) ; Ichihara et al. (2026) show that OPSD does not rely on privileged information, but on thinking-mode transfer. In contrast to these works, we provide our results with an exact reproduction of SDPO and OPSD training and evaluating settings, and we ask whether SDPO’s gains in other domains reflect improvements in reasoning.
blocks.zh: 经验再评价. 王等编. (2026年)证明,SDPO努力将分布域归纳为外分域,并在GRPO成功的持续学习环境中失败. 考尔等. (2026年)强调自沉会贬低思维模式;之前的作品主要以教学调制模式为主. 与我们一起工作的还有Shrestha和Tessier(2026); Zhang等 (2026); Ichihara等 (2026) 显示OPSD不依赖特权信息,而是依赖思维-模式转移. 与这些作品相反,我们提供了我们的成果,精确地复制了SDPO和OPSD的培训和评估设置,我们问SDPO在其他领域的收益是否反映了推理方面的改进.

blocks.en: Token-level symptoms. Kim et al. (2026) ; Kaur et al. (2026) ; Pan et al. (2026) ; Harne et al. (2026) show that self-distillation losses concentrate on tokens which express uncertainty and have high entropy. This results in a suppression of the student’s backtracking behavior and collapse in response lengths. Instead, we focus on the positive results reported by OPSD, and find through token-level diagnoses and response length metrics, that performance improvements relate to thinking-mode transfer.
blocks.zh: 托肯级症状. Kim等 (2026年); Kaur等 (2026年); Pan等 (2026年); Harne等 (2026年) 表明自沉损失集中于表示不确定性并具有高py的活物. 这导致学生的倒行逆施行为被压制,并在响应长度上崩溃. 相反,我们侧重于OPSD报告的积极结果,并通过象征性的诊断和反应长度衡量,发现性能的改进与思维模式的转移有关。

blocks.en: Sequence-level diagnoses. Nguyen et al. (2026) develop statistics that indicate that the self-conditioned teacher cannot differentiate between correct and incorrect solutions generated by the student. Harne et al. (2026) present analogous results, showing that the self-conditioned teacher is greatly biased towards the reference solution it is provided, mirroring Yang et al. (2026) ’s results indicating that the teacher leaks privileged information. On the other hand, we diagnose whether the self-conditioned teacher approximates the optimal KL-regularized model, which is an assumption behind prior self-distillation work ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 序列级诊断. Nguyen等 (2026年)发展出统计数据,表明自备条件的教师无法区分学生产生的正确与不正确的解决方案. 哈恩等编. (2026年)提出了类似的结果,表明自备条件的老师对所提供的参考解决方案有很大的偏向,反映了杨等(2026年)的结果显示老师泄露了特权信息. 另一方面,我们判断自建条件的教师是否与最佳的KL规范化模式相近,这是先前自建工程背后的假设(Shenfeld等,2026年).

blocks.en: Remedies. Pan et al. (2026) and Yang et al. (2026) retain GRPO as a learning signal and use the self-conditioned teacher only to modulate its per-token advantages. Because these methods do not rely on the self-distillation loss alone, which is the setting we study, they fall outside the scope of this work. Their reliance on GRPO is consistent with Harne et al. (2026) , who question whether the self-distillation objective on its own, without such auxiliary machinery, yields any performance gains at all.
blocks.zh: 补救措施。 潘等 (2026)和杨等. (2026年)保留了GRPO作为学习信号,并使用自备条件的老师只来调制其每托子的优点. 由于这些方法并不只依赖于自我消化损失,而这正是我们研究的背景,因此它们不属于这项工作的范围。 他们对GRPO的依赖与Harne等人(2026年)是一致的,他质疑没有这种辅助机械的自沉目标本身能否产生任何性能上的收益.

blocks.en: Appendix C Qwen3 thinking modes
blocks.zh: 附录 C Quen3 思维模式

blocks.en:
Qwen3 models support a thinking and a non-thinking mode in the same model ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) . For the flagship models (Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-235B-A22B), the two modes are merged during post-training ( Thinking Mode Fusion ) by fine-tuning on a mixture of “thinking” and “non-thinking” data. The smaller models (Qwen3 0.6B to 14B and Qwen3-30B-A3B) inherit both of these modes through supervised fine-tuning and on-policy-distillation from the flagship models. Concretely, in thinking mode, the model reasons inside a <think> … </think> block before responding. The mode is toggled via the enable_thinking argument of the chat template. When it is set to False, an empty think block is prefilled in the assistant turn: <|im_start|>assistant
<think>

blocks.en: All our experiments are run were run with 8xH100 nodes (with no multi-node parallelism), primarily leveraging the vLLM inference engine ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) . We run our experiments on top of the OPSD codebase written in TRL ( von Werra et al., 2020 ) and the SDPO codebase which uses veRL ( Sheng et al., 2024 ) . Our SDPO LCBv6 runs train for ∼ \sim 40 hours, while the SDPO science and tool use jobs took ∼ \sim 3 hours. OPSD runs took up to ∼ \sim 2 hours and GRPO runs on the OpenThoughts dataset took up to ∼ \sim 6 hours. OPSD thinking-on evaluations took up to ∼ \sim 2.5 hours per dataset and OPSD thinking-off evaluations took up to ∼ \sim 1 hour per dataset. Our gradient similarity analyses took up to ∼ \sim 2 hours per training setting.
blocks.zh: 我们所有的实验都用8xH100节点运行(没有多节点平行),主要利用了vLLM推论引擎(Kwon等,2023年). 我们的实验是在TRL(von Werra等,2020年)和使用veRL(Sheng等,2024年)的SDPO代码库之上进行的。 我们的SDPO LCBv6开行了40小时的列车,而SDPO的科学和工具使用工作则需要 \ sim 3小时。 OpenThoughts的数据集运行了6小时。 OPSD思考式评价每个数据集花费了2.5小时,OPSD思考式评价每个数据集花费了1小时。 我们的梯度相似度分析每次训练最多需要2小时。

blocks.en: E.3 Gradient similarity analysis
blocks.zh: E.3 梯度相似度分析

blocks.en: We record each method’s gradients by running its training loop from the base model with learning rate zero, so the weights never change, and averaging the gradients over all iterations of each run for downstream computation. We use the hyperparameters of Tables 22 and 24 , with two exceptions: GRPO uses num_iterations = 1 =1 , since at learning rate zero a second pass over the same rollouts gives the same gradient, and we record gradients with respect to all parameters rather than the LoRA adapters (for the math results), since LoRA’s zero-initialized matrices may lead to poorly defined gradient behavior. We run 64 iterations per seed for OPSD on OpenThoughts and 8 for SDPO on LiveCodeBench v6, with four seeds per method.
